Whole D18 head/fork exclusion and independent actual-rank19–29 tail, then the published ceiling.
Actual-field chain inventories, golden lattice input, simultaneous helper/foot payments and spectator-uniform energy estimates.
Empty two cubic A17 finite-anchor domains.
Two necessary shared quadratic B/D17 pairs, with distinct actual geometric inclusions and consumers.
One necessary whole B16 quadratic pair, with its separate geometric exclusion.
Complete rank 17 and rank 16 covers and all consumers reduce to the necessary whole D16 quadratic triple.
Manual odd/inert/ramified/split dyadic exclusion and final arithmetic bound 15 deduction; no whole D16 census premise.
